title: Free Samples
body: The professors want to conduct a mid-semester survey. They wish to gather feedback from all the students enrolled in Data $$\frac{100}{200}$$ but have determined that it will be easier to take a small sample instead. They propose a couple of different methods to record this survey. For the remainder of this question, the Python RegEx library has been imported as re. For all parts, you will only need to worry about the example strings given to you and may assume that these examples cover all edge cases.
